caption: The drawing consists of two main horizontal sections. The upper section is a narrow band with a blue background, decorated with a repeating pattern of tan or light brown ornamental shapes resembling floral motifs and simple four-petal flower shapes, all outlined in a slightly darker brown. The lower section, which occupies the majority of the composition, features a beige background filled with a repeating pattern of large, overlapping maple leaves in a lighter beige or cream color, outlined with fine brown lines that indicate their veins. Both the top and bottom edges of the drawing are bordered by a thin strip in a similar tan color with tiny dots marking the border. The overall composition is rectangular, with the floral band running horizontally above the area with the maple leaves.
title: Wall Paper
